title: Conditional κ = 7.54077687633330e-4: 438 early restorations (endpoint-aware banks) after the squares on #310's w3 word (+0.0755% over #311)
body:
Conditional κ = `754077687633330234295251/10^27` = **7.54077687633330234295251e-4**, +0.0755 % over [#311](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/311) (7.53508664880762e-4), +0.157 % over [#310](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/310)'s w3 word. Below [#312](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/312) (draft, 7.54550e-4, kernels/squares/plateau/reorder with #304's supplier); this PR contributes the stage #312 reports as blocked — early restorations with endpoints below the full frame — and its composition with #312's stages follows.

One self-contained package, `research/w3-restore/` (#311's package with one more native transcript stage), with its own workflow; branched from `main`, no existing file changed.

**Full replay: PASS** (`verify.py --output`, ~10 minutes locally): both prerequisite source verifiers fresh, the squares, the restoration stage, legality, all 23,627 global and 22,172 compact F₂ columns, the endpoint-aware bank allocation, 22,806 changed charts, geometry admission, exact price (nine ordinary levels, two engines, 47 strict constraints, adjacent grid point rejected), finite invoice, complex guard and `finish.py`; prints `PASS conditional kappa = 754077687633330234295251/1000000000000000000000000000`.

## Change

**438 early restorations on w3** — [#280](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/280)'s rule and its own screen/emitter (`code/cleanup_screen.py`, `code/cleanup_emit.py`, re-pinned to this word). At the first `cleanup_gate` ADD (record 962,945) every data target already has its scalar endpoints (checked on the exact F₂ prefix); 440 helpers `a` have a single later scalar incidence `a −= b` with a donor unwritten in between, both at rank-22 frames with a nondegenerate 23-dimensional span `E` (#280's shape; 477 further multi-incidence candidates at dimension 3 are not moved). With 40 physical replicas the restored width-3 slots must tile width-120 banks, so 438 are moved (438·40 = 146·120 — #280's own 438/440 distinction). The write commutes over the integers with every crossed gate; `a` and `b` advance to `E`, the ADD runs there and `a` retires at `E`. The emitter checks each new frame's full-rank annihilator and nonzero cleared Gram determinant mod 2¹²⁷ − 1, the commutation conditions, forward/inverse/roundtrip F₂ replays and an omitted-restoration control. Local delta {1: +1314, 2: −876}; rank mass 398,897 → 398,459; endpoint residual 317,409 → 316,971.

**Admission of endpoints below the full frame.** `code/cohort-bank-review.cpp` now reads the candidate's `COHORT249-FINAL.json` and a tiling plan (`inputs/bank-plan.json`): each helper's residual width is dim(endpoint) − dim(entrance) (#310's census is reproduced when nothing is restored); the plan is an exact integer tiling (small ILP over patterns of ≤ 3 widths; 105,657 banks per stage) that the C++ verifies in full — width census, collision-free tiling of all 3,026,400 role/replica/stage slots, every bank a full 120-coordinate partition, the per-pattern endpoint and omission/repetition controls, exact charts (3,911 new, ≤ 320 factors) — with the generic stock invariant. Legality runs against the candidate's declared endpoints with the export's base frame table; the changed-chart audit covers the 2,703 retired endpoints (≤ 342 factors). Literal stock 810,615 → 809,885 (normalized 161,977); finite coefficient 58,322,299,353,183,001 < 2⁸⁰; selector charge 571,950,385,600 < 2⁴⁰. Re-pinned: `code/admit_geometry.py`, `code/price.py` (word hash `8f05b2af…`, 3,687,240 calls, mass 19,402,040, κ, 9 levels), `code/finish.py`.

With #233's complex supplier the complex side would bind at 7.5413e-4 for any further bit-side gain; the composition with #312 therefore uses #304's supplier as #312 does.
